1: Together we will follow the path of twigs (independent clause)  
2: and together we will die (independent clause)  
3: Once more he shouldered his burden (independent clause)  
4: how light it seemed now (parenthetical clause)  
5: and hastened down the path (independent clause)  
6: through the shadows and the moonlight (prepositional phrase, part of clause 5)  
7: to the little hut in the valley (prepositional phrase, part of clause 5)
